records.excerpt: Natural England describes Sites of Special Scientific Interest as land notified under the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981, covering England, with no public access constraints and Open Government Licence reuse subject to attribution.
records.web_line_scope: dataset summary, use limitation, licence, attribution, publisher and reference dates
records.record_scope: official dataset definition, publisher, access and licence

records.excerpt: The official Natural England SSSI layer is an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer, supports JSON queries, has maximum record count 1000 and publishes OBJECTID, REF_CODE, NAME, MEASURE, LABEL, HYPERLINK and CONTACT_NO fields.
records.web_line_scope: ArcGIS layer name, geometry type, supported query formats, record limit, spatial reference and field list
records.record_scope: official queryable layer schema and bounded field set

records.excerpt: Natural England states that where possible it publishes data under the Open Government Licence, which permits commercial and non-commercial use with source acknowledgement, and directs users to its Open Data Geoportal and Data.GOV.UK.
records.web_line_scope: open data and copyright, download maps and data, Open Data Geoportal and Data.GOV.UK sections

records.excerpt: Natural England's official SSSI collection identifies SSSIs as designated areas in England and links guidance for landowners, public bodies, condition assessments, consent and designation changes.
records.web_line_scope: collection heading, description and linked guidance categories
records.record_scope: official interpretation boundary for SSSI designation context

records.excerpt: The National Data Library collection describes SSSIs as designated areas of ecological or geological significance and identifies Natural England as the data provider.
records.web_line_scope: collection description, provider and available data formats
